claim.claim-text: 1. Method of assembling a drug delivery device (1, 101),

wherein the drug delivery device (1, 101) comprises a control subassembly and a drive subassembly (1.1, 101.1), wherein the drive subassembly (1.1, 101.1) comprises a plunger (10, 110), a drive spring (9, 109) and a rear case (2.2), wherein the control subassembly comprises a cap (11), a needle shroud (7, 307) and a front case (2.1), wherein during assembly, a syringe (3) with an attached needle (4, 104) and a protective needle sheath (5) is inserted into the control subassembly in the distal direction, and wherein afterwards, the drive subassembly (1.1, 101.1) is inserted into the control subassembly in the distal direction.

2. The method according to claim 1, comprising the steps of bending a resilient force member (13.1, 113.1) about a longitudinal axis (L, L100) extending from a first end of the resilient force member (13.1, 113.1) to a second end of the resilient force member (13.1, 113.1) located opposite the first end.

3. The method according to claim 2, wherein the bending plastically deforms the resilient force member (13.1, 113.1) to form two wing-shaped sections angled relative to each other about the longitudinal axis (L, L100).

4. The method according to claim 2 or 3, including flexing the resilient force member (13.1, 113.1) about an axis (A) running substantially perpendicular to the longitudinal axis (L, L100) and to the bend formed by the bending.
5. The method according to claim 4, wherein the flexing elastically deforms the resilient force member (13.1, 113.1), converting its state from a relaxed state (S1) to a biased state (S2).

6. The method according to claim 5, wherein the biased state (S2) is maintained with a support, preferably with a flexible arm (15.2) arranged on a rear case (2.2) of the drug delivery device (1, 101), where one or more additional or retaining forces are applied to the resilient force member (13.1, 113.1) to maintain the biased state (S2).

7. The method according to claim 5 or 6, wherein converting a monostable resilient force member from the biased state (S2) to the relaxed state (S1) requires at least partial removal of a retaining force from the resilient force member (13.1, 113.1).

8. The method according to any one of the claims 5 to 7, wherein the resilient force member (13.1, 113.1) is configured such that a conversion from the biased state (S2) to the relaxed state (S1) causes the resilient force member (13.1, 113.1) to generate a loud sound signal, especially a sound signal with a volume of at least 100 dB.

9. The method according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the method includes coupling of the resilient force member (13.1, 113.1) of the drug delivery device (1, 101) to one or more parts of the drug delivery device (1, 101).
10. The method according to claim 9, comprising coupling the resilient force member (13.1, 113.1) movingly to the one or the more parts of the drug delivery device (1, 101).
11. The method according to claim 10, wherein moveable coupling includes locating at least part of the resilient force member (13.1, 113.1) within a complementary recess.

12. The method according to claim 10 or 11, wherein the resilient force member (13.1, 113.1) includes one or more protrusions (13.3) designed to fit generally within one or more complementary recesses or openings.

13. The method according to claim 12, wherein the protrusions are tabs (13.3) projecting radially from the outer circumference of the resilient force member (13.1, 113.1, 213.1, 313.1, 413.1, 513.1, 613.1), wherein preferably the tabs (13.3) are angled with respect to wing shaped sections of the resilient force member (13.1, 113.1, 213.1, 313.1, 413.1, 513.1, 613.1), preferably to facilitate assembling of the drug delivery device (1, 101, 201, 301, 401, 501, 601).

14. The method according to claim 12 or 13, wherein the protrusions, preferably tabs (13.3) or the tabs (13.3) are engaged within a number of corresponding openings in the rear case (2.2) of the drug delivery device (1, 101, 201, 301, 401, 501, 601) by a snap connection.
15. The method according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein the drug delivery device (1, 101, 201, 301, 401, 501, 601) comprises a drug container (3) comprising a drug (M).
